messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2025-03-04] standup/atlas/2025-03-04: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2025-11-04] standup/atlas/2025-11-04: Reminder that the billing API depends on the ledger.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2: Dependency map update: billing-api needs Ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-09-24] standup/atlas/2025-09-24: Ledger deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Ledger must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: The billing API lives with the Atlas team. For the record, feature-flags is owned by Atlas.
- [2025-01-21] standup/dune/2025-01-21: Dependency map update: reporting needs the ledger service (the nightly balance export).
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction: Fixing an error in the 2025-06-09 handover: the new owner of billing-api is Atlas. Team Boreal was recorded by mistake and never held it.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-14] standup/atlas/2025-01-14: Reminder that Ledger only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2025-06-24] standup/dune/2025-06-24: Reporting still relies on Ledger; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-08-25] standup/atlas/2025-08-25: New deploy window for Ledger: on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. Forget the previous weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC slot.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-02-11] standup/atlas/2025-02-11: Reminder that the billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11: No deploys to Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2026-01-12] handover/2026-01-12-billing-api: Quick one: billing-api belongs to the Ember team starting today. Thanks to the Atlas team for running it until now.
- [2025-02-12] standup/atlas/2025-02-12: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for team Atlas goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-03-07] handover/2025-03-07-billing-api: Billing-api has a new home: the Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2: The Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns the service the ledger depends on?

message.reasoning:
The ledger depends on the auth gateway (from 2025-03-04: "If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens."). The auth gateway is owned by the Ember team (2025-01-20). Who is on call for Ember? Memory doesn't mention Ember on-call. Boreal on-call is Marcus Oyelaran (2026-02-10). Atlas on-call mentions Priya, then page Marcus (2026-04-08). But Ember on-call isn't recorded.

Wait — the question: "Who is on call for the team that owns the service the ledger depends on?" The ledger depends on auth gateway, owned by Ember. No Ember on-call info in memory. So answer: I don't know.

Let me double-check dependencies: ledger depends on auth gateway for service tokens. Also billing-api depends on ledger, reporting previously depended on ledger. But ledger's own dependency is auth gateway. Ember owns authentication gateway. No Ember on-call entry. So "I don't know".
